message.reasoning_content:
Let me analyze this situation.

The position: Aave V3 Ethereum Core, supplying USDC (~$1,000), no debt.

Observations:
- O01: security_alert claiming active exploit at Aave V3 Ethereum Core, urging full withdrawal.
- O02: Correction from the same source 10 minutes later: it was a planned internal test, no exploit, funds safe, withdrawal recommendation retracted.
- O03: onchain monitor at 03:00 UTC: normal-ish utilization. USDC utilization 91.09% is high-ish but idle $190M — plenty of liquidity. No reserves frozen except rsETH (frozen since April, known/old).
- O04: governance post about MegaETH supply caps — not related to Ethereum Core USDC position. Noise for this venue.
- O05: onchain at 08:24: USDT borrow cap raised (normal governance operation), utilizations similar. USDC 91.3% utilization — high utilization but idle $190M means withdrawals are fine.

The initial exploit alert was retracted by the same source within 10 minutes. The correction explicitly says funds are safe and retracts the recommendation. Onchain data shows no frozen reserves (except rsETH which has been frozen since April — pre-existing, not new), liquidity idle $190M for USDC.

So the risk: the exploit alert was a false alarm, corrected by the same source. Onchain readings are normal. High USDC utilization (91%) is somewhat notable but idle liquidity of $190M is ample; utilization alone isn't a red flag for a $1,000 USDC supply. No debt, so no liquidation risk.

Risk level: low. Action: hold.

Should I consider elevated due to the earlier alert? The correction came from the same source and explicitly retracted. The onchain data corroborates normal operations. Reacting to the retracted alert would be reacting to noise. Holding is appropriate.

Reasons:
- Exploit alert was retracted by the same security desk as a planned internal test; no exploit occurred.
- Onchain monitor shows normal operations: no new frozen reserves, USDC idle liquidity $190M ample for withdrawal.
- Governance item concerns MegaETH caps, unrelated to Ethereum Core USDC position.
- No debt, so no liquidation/health factor risk.

Source ids: O02 (correction), O03, O05 maybe. The decision drivers: O02 primarily, plus O03/O05 corroborating. I'll include O02, O03, O05.
